name: avatar
title: Blobatar
description: An Avatar that falls back to a deterministic geometric blobatar generated from the user's name.
author: Alain <https://blobatar.dev>

name: presence-avatar
title: Presence avatar
description: A blobatar with a presence dot and an unread badge. Online, away, offline, and a thinking state, on a face that blinks and breathes.
author: Alain <https://blobatar.dev>

name: agent-list
title: Agent list
description: A sidebar group of running agents, each with a face derived from its name, a presence dot and a line of what it is doing. Drops into shadcn's Sidebar.
author: Alain <https://blobatar.dev>

name: user-table
title: User table
description: A table of people with a blobatar per row, rendered as static images so that a long list stays one node per face.
author: Alain <https://blobatar.dev>

name: group-chat
title: Group chat
description: A thread with several people in it: consecutive messages grouped under one face, an overlapping facepile, and a typing indicator.
author: Alain <https://blobatar.dev>

name: password-field
title: Password field
description: A password input with a face above it. It watches the caret while you type, and goes sleepy when you reveal what you typed.
author: Alain <https://blobatar.dev>
